title: PHAROS Method Formation Atlas
normalization_principle: Unify by coordinate, not by collapse. A complete method claim combines corpus position, intellectual function, temporal relation, and operational embodiment while retaining the evidentiary limits of each source artifact.

canonical_formula.note: The multiplication sign indicates that the coordinates constrain one another. It does not imply a quantitative model.

evidence_labels.record: Explicitly stated or directly documented in one or more source artifacts.
evidence_labels.bounded_synthesis: Cross-source interpretation that is supported but not itself a primary artifact fact.
evidence_labels.provisional: Plausible interpretation that remains unresolved or dependent on unavailable evidence.

artifacts.title: The Register
artifacts.primary_question: What exists, in what form and status, and what did each work contribute to method formation?
artifacts.unit_of_analysis: Individual works, forms, apparatus, status, venue history, archive findings, and method-stage position
artifacts.time_logic: Functional order. Sequence follows contribution to method formation rather than composition or publication date.
artifacts.evidence_mode: Manuscripts, bibliographies, submission packages, file-system inspection, counts, and correction logs
artifacts.singular_contribution: Preserves the plurality of the corpus. It prevents works outside the governance spine from being treated as absent or irrelevant and makes form, status, and archival condition visible.
artifacts.authority_limit: It can establish inventory and documented status. It cannot by itself prove a causal intellectual lineage or identify every conceptual handoff.

artifacts.title: How Agatha Became a Governance Method
artifacts.primary_question: How did a concern with authority, mediation, proof, interruption, and legitimacy become an AI-governance method?
artifacts.unit_of_analysis: Conceptual handoffs between fields, works, laboratories, operators, failure modes, and governance controls
artifacts.time_logic: Causal-functional sequence. Ground → launch → laboratory → executable governance → hardening.
artifacts.evidence_mode: Close interpretive reading across the corpus, with explicit bridge claims and a discipline caveat against retroactive conscription
artifacts.singular_contribution: Names the through-concept and explains why the stages belong to one program without turning every earlier paper into an AI-governance paper.
artifacts.authority_limit: It explains relation and purpose. It does not establish archive completeness, submission status, or implementation provenance.
artifacts.method_role: Causal grammar of the research program

artifacts.title: Sixteen Years and Five Months
artifacts.primary_question: How does the five-month Voice Operator lineage relate to the longer intellectual history that begins in 2010?
artifacts.unit_of_analysis: Dated crossing points, recurrences, gaps, compressions, and primary-source corrections
artifacts.time_logic: Two clocks on one axis. A sixteen-year ring is compared with a five-month implementation lineage.
artifacts.evidence_mode: Primary thesis reading, chronology, comparison of register and genealogy, and explicit correction of unsupported bridge claims
artifacts.singular_contribution: Prevents implementation speed from being mistaken for intellectual origin. It distinguishes the recent encoding of a method from the longer recurrence of its structural commitments.
artifacts.authority_limit: Structural recurrence is not identical to documented intentional inheritance. It can support continuity claims without converting similarity into proven descent.

artifacts.title: Voice Operator Specs — A Genealogy
artifacts.primary_question: How did prose rules, governance operators, personas, GPTs, agents, skills, and the paper pipeline inherit and transform one another?
artifacts.unit_of_analysis: Operators, tokens, hashes, timestamps, bindings, instantiations, layers, gates, handoffs, and unresolved gaps
artifacts.time_logic: Version and layer history concentrated in 2026. It separates sequence from strata.
artifacts.evidence_mode: Opened files, hashes, GPT identifier timestamps, inheritance tables, source ledger, and confidence labels
artifacts.singular_contribution: Shows where the method became executable. It distinguishes operator change from persona binding, product instantiation, agent scope, and skill extraction.
artifacts.authority_limit: It can prove operational inheritance where artifacts exist. It cannot alone establish the full intellectual origin of the method or make unsupported stages direct evidence.

method_phases.name: Deep structural substrate
method_phases.record: The MA thesis identifies a fixed, non-interchangeable âme / double / ombre triad and a rule against role collapse.
method_phases.register: Position 00 once restored to the corpus horizon.
method_phases.arc: Pre-ground rather than the AI launch. It supplies a recurrent structural commitment, not an AI-governance vocabulary.
method_phases.timeline: Primary temporal anchor and the basis for the sixteen-year ring.
method_phases.genealogy: A claimed substrate that the genealogy initially cited indirectly.

method_phases.name: Authority observed in situated practice
method_phases.record: Queer neo-Pagan fieldwork and scholarship study legitimacy, ritual negotiation, agency, refusal, and authority without stable institutional backing.
method_phases.register: Stage I, with the published ethnographic and religious-studies record.
method_phases.arc: The ground. Refusal-to-cohere and sacred subversion become the primitive.
method_phases.timeline: Long intellectual duration before the 2026 operator build.
method_phases.genealogy: Not part of the short implementation chain.

method_phases.name: Cultural rehearsal and the joint
method_phases.record: Screen and cultural works rehearse how authority is staged, made credible, domesticated, refused, or rendered illegible. The Scythe Already in Motion performs the fieldwork-to-screen passage.
method_phases.register: Stage I-bis and Stage II. Position 13b is the fieldwork-to-screen joint. Position 26 turns specifically toward machine autonomy.
method_phases.arc: The screen archives and governance probes. Cultural materials become diagnostic test objects.
method_phases.timeline: Part of the long formation, not the five-month operator chronology.
method_phases.genealogy: Supplies concepts and probes, not operator-version evidence.

method_phases.name: AI inquiry launched through regimes of proof
method_phases.record: Agatha formulates authority as a regime of proof and makes mediation pathways, rather than artifacts alone, the object of evaluation.
method_phases.register: Located among the cultural studies record and later method vocabulary.
method_phases.arc: Explicit launch of the AI endeavor.
method_phases.timeline: Recent articulation built on older structures.
method_phases.genealogy: Conceptual predecessor, not yet an executable operator lineage.

method_phases.name: Laboratories, charge, and governance probes
method_phases.record: Hexa and Wheels of Will function as controlled environments. Charge separates efficacy from authorization. Cultural and creative works expose patterned drift.
method_phases.register: Stages II and IV, with Sealed Card and Charging Objects entering the formal spine at Stage V.
method_phases.arc: The laboratory phase. Raw material → rendering → comparison → drift detection → control.
method_phases.timeline: Accelerated experimentation near the 2026 encoding period.
method_phases.genealogy: Provides the problems that later controls mechanize.

method_phases.name: The problem is lived and produced
method_phases.record: The voice and dysfluency lane identifies fluency as a tacit proxy for rigor. AI-assisted long-form production makes continuity, drift, and over-coherence practical problems.
method_phases.arc: Anti-fluency and production failure become direct governance requirements.
method_phases.timeline: Explains why the 2026 formalization could be rapid.
method_phases.genealogy: Family A translates these pressures into prose operators and machine safety rules.

method_phases.name: Governance becomes executable
method_phases.record: Prose operators and governance operators are encoded, fused, instantiated, redistributed into agents, and extracted as skills.
method_phases.register: Reflected in Stage V method papers and the Scholarly Paper Project OS, but not fully described by work status alone.
method_phases.arc: The turn from analysis to control.
method_phases.genealogy: Core domain. Family A, Family B, instantiation track, four layers, and cross-layer skills.

method_phases.name: Failure modes and recursive hardening
method_phases.record: Delegation failure, method lock, self-validation, deferred authority, compulsory coherence, and opacity are named and tested.
method_phases.register: Stage V, the load-bearing method sequence.
method_phases.arc: The complex papers name what breaks after governance becomes executable.
method_phases.timeline: A recent hardening layer rather than the origin of the underlying commitments.
method_phases.genealogy: Controls propagate into gates, markers, handoffs, refusal conditions, and pipeline nodes.

method_phases.name: Convergence, limits, and falsifiability
method_phases.record: Verification Without Trust defines admissibility through checkable residue. The Pharos Frame states the frame and its falsification conditions.
method_phases.register: Stage VI. Position 63 is the limiting result and position 64 names the frame.
method_phases.arc: The regime of proof becomes an end-to-end evidence discipline.
method_phases.timeline: The current endpoint still returns to earlier questions of authority and legibility.
method_phases.genealogy: Evidence labels, promotion gates, author verification, and source ledgers operationalize the limit.

method_phases.name: Operational externalization
method_phases.record: The method appears in the Scholarly Paper Project OS, published GPTs, product tools, client systems, and cross-platform skills.
method_phases.register: Product and archive findings expand the corpus beyond papers and reveal multiple portfolio tiers.
method_phases.arc: Terminal form of the method, with a caveat that not every product or earlier cultural work belongs to the same lineage.
method_phases.timeline: The live present where the long ring and short lineage meet.
method_phases.genealogy: The currently executing form. Skills become callable across platforms without duplicating content.

typed_hinges.transition: A fixed triadic structure and anti-collapse commitment becomes visible long before the agent architecture.
typed_hinges.why_not_competing: This is a substrate claim, not the start of the AI endeavor.

typed_hinges.transition: Ethnographic inquiry and media analysis are performed as one argument.
typed_hinges.why_not_competing: This is the joint between Stage I and Stage II.

typed_hinges.transition: The screen vocabulary turns specifically toward machine autonomy and self-authorship.
typed_hinges.why_not_competing: This is narrower than the fieldwork-to-screen joint.

typed_hinges.transition: The evaluation of mediated ritual authority is redirected toward AI-mediated production.
typed_hinges.why_not_competing: This is the launch of the AI endeavor, not the first appearance of the underlying method.

typed_hinges.artifact: Voice Operator families and Final Voice Operator
typed_hinges.transition: Rules about voice, evidence, propagation, and refusal become machine-readable and enforceable.
The method specifies what self-generated evidence can legitimately establish.
typed_hinges.why_not_competing: This is the epistemic limit, not an origin.

typed_hinges.artifact: Pourquoi rêver encore ? against the 2010 thesis
typed_hinges.transition: The corpus returns to the same Rivard objects with the later method’s instruments.
typed_hinges.why_not_competing: This recalibrates the shape of the history without erasing the functional arc.

relations.rule: A2 may interpret A1 positions but may not overwrite A1 form, status, or archival distinctions.
A1 gains explanatory context without turning all works into one genre or project.
The 2010 thesis and terminal return must remain visible even when the register is ordered by function.
Fast implementation may indicate prior structure, but recurrence must not be restated as proven direct descent.
Conceptual handoffs become controls only where specifications, inheritance, or operational artifacts support the claim.
GPTs, agents, skills, and pipeline artifacts are not papers and require their own artifact classes.
The intellectual sequence and temporal recurrence are complementary geometries, not rival chronologies.

relations.type: provides test cases and method papers
relations.rule: Works can supply probes or concepts without becoming operator versions.

preserved_tensions.record: A2 presents a developmental arc. A3 shows a return to the 2010 object and therefore a ring.
preserved_tensions.normalization: Use the arc for functional handoffs and the ring for temporal recurrence. Neither geometry replaces the other.

preserved_tensions.record: A4 finds that personas, GPTs, agents, native agents, and skills were flattened into one arrow chain.
preserved_tensions.normalization: Track function, layer, binding, instantiation, and version separately. A repeated name is not proof of identity, and a renamed function is not proof of change.

preserved_tensions.tension: Two origin substrates versus structural continuity
preserved_tensions.record: A4 separates the operator lineage from Queen Keyport’s fictional substrate. A3 argues that the 2010 âme position may already contain the vacancy structure.
preserved_tensions.normalization: Retain both claims. The operator lineage and fiction have distinct documentary origins. The deeper structural relation remains a supported interpretation, not a collapsed genealogy.

preserved_tensions.tension: Cultural work as probe versus independent scholarship
preserved_tensions.record: A2 identifies cultural material as governance infrastructure while warning against retroactive conscription.
preserved_tensions.normalization: A work may contribute a concept, probe, or method function without being reclassified as an AI-governance paper.

preserved_tensions.record: A4 identifies stages whose confidence increased without stronger evidence. A3 shows the same issue around the 2010 bridge.
preserved_tensions.normalization: Record functional equivalence as synthesis. Reserve lineage claims for opened, dated, hashed, cited, or otherwise traceable artifacts.

preserved_tensions.record: A1 was repeatedly corrected by files hidden under unexpected names, classifier categories, duplicate forms, and untracked submission histories.
preserved_tensions.normalization: Treat A1 as a versioned index with provenance, not a timeless final count. Counts remain tables by artifact class.

preserved_tensions.tension: Fiction as designed experiment versus retained production artifact
preserved_tensions.record: A4 finds that the Keyport two-arm structure is methodologically significant while the decisive break originated in a generation cutoff that was retained.
preserved_tensions.normalization: Preserve both the experimental reading and the provenance of the break. Do not restate an emergent artifact as an authored outcome.

preserved_tensions.tension: Governance personified versus governance made portable
preserved_tensions.record: Queen Keyport functions as a vacant office because embodiment risks converting governance into a usable service.
preserved_tensions.normalization: Describe Queen Keyport as a domain of answerability or coupling condition where the source supports it. Do not reduce the office to another capability agent.

non_supersession_rule: No artifact in this package supersedes another. Each remains authoritative only for its own unit of analysis and evidence mode.
